page_title: JUV 2-0 UDI | Juventus v Udinese 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+2' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Francisco Conceicao is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Kenan Yildiz can be given a rest.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

88' 2 - 0 GOAL! A great pass finds Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 2:0.
87' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
85' 12:3 – the corner kicks stats.
82' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Igor Tudor has decided to substitute Weston McKennie and he is replaced by Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
79' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) is replacing Christian Kabasele.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) comes onto the pitch for Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
73' Igor Tudor decides to make a substitution. Randal Kolo Muani will be replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
72' Substitution. Timothy Weah (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Andrea Cambiaso walks off.
70' Juventus are seeing far more of the ball now.
67' Total attempts – 19:6.
64' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' 1 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
60' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Rui Modesto (Udinese) replaces Sandi Lovric.
59' Udinese hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
57' 68:32 – the ratio of ball possession.
55' It seemed like Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
53' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

52' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
50' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' Udinese players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' The whistle blows and Giovanni Ayroldi starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+2' Now Udinese have a corner.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
42' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
40' 13:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
38' A short pass finds Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
37' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.
36' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Maduka Okoye.
34' Poor challenge! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is penalised for tripping and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle.
31' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
29' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is substituted due to injury. Kosta Runjaic gives a chance to Jordan Zemura.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
27' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Di Gregorio, who smothers the ball.
24' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
17' 64:36 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
14' Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
13' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Giovanni Ayroldi signals a set piece.
12' The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
9' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
7' The Juventus players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
5' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
3' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
1' The first half has just begun.

The referee of today's match will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
